title: Making a vampire survivor style game. Early build I'd be happy if someone wants to check it.
author: taiga7us
selftext:
As it says in the tytle. Nothing too special yet, just the basic vampire survivors gameplay, but I'm planning on adding story and progression moving forward. 

Even this took quite a while to make as it is. 

For reference, I used pixellab for the pixel art, working on top of some manual pixel art drawing and editing with novelai.

background assets are codex/chatgpt image. 

coding was just back and forth with claude code. 

You can take a look at it here:

[https://fumetsunotora.itch.io/dawnweaver-loose-ends](https://fumetsunotora.itch.io/dawnweaver-loose-ends)
